item.title: Observra 1.1: Bring Observability to Any AI Agent
item.dc:creator: Steve Wilson
item.description: Observra 1.1 opens its telemetry pipeline to any custom agent framework — no adapter required — plus local storage, a live terminal dashboard, and support for 100+ LLM providers.

item.title: "Praxen 1.2: Now Aligned to the 2026 OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications"
item.dc:creator: Steve Wilson
item.description: Praxen 1.2 aligns risk findings to the 2026 OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, with clearer scoring, scan-to-scan comparisons, and a new shareable Worker Remit.
